linear_calibration.description: assume the initial rate is proportional to free Fab (no calibration curvature)
edits:
return r / (a - b * r) if a - b * r > 0 else np.inf
            return r / a

nominal_active.description: assume the Fab stock is fully active (active fraction fixed at 1)

no_depletion.description: hyperbolic free fraction (IC50 = KD), i.e. ignore ligand depletion
edits:
model = free_fab(f * nom, ag, kd) / f
            model = nom * kd / (kd + ag)

later_window.description: initial-rate window 10-50 s instead of 5-40 s

relative_residuals.description: weight each Fab series by 1/nominal concentration although the rate noise is homoscedastic (a statistics error, not claimed as an SPR trap)
edits:
return (model - free) * 1e9  # rate noise is homoscedastic in free-Fab units
            return (model - free) / nom
